steganography.definition: n act of writing in code or cipher

steganopodes.definition:
n. pl. A division of swimming birds in which all four
   toes are united by a broad web. It includes the pelicans, cormorants,
   gannets, and others.

stegnobinone.translation: 二氢三甲基甲氧丁基吡喃酮

stegnosis.definition:
n. Constipation; also, constriction of the vessels or
   ducts.

stegnotic.definition:
a. Tending to render costive, or to diminish excretions or
   discharges generally.
n. A stegnotic medicine; an astringent.
stegnotic.translation:
n. 收敛药
a. 狭窄(性)的

stegosaur.definition: n. herbivorous ornithischian dinosaur with a row of bony plates along its back and a spiked tail probably used as a weapon

stegosauria.definition:
n. pl. An extinct order of herbivorous dinosaurs,
   including the genera Stegosaurus, Omosaurus, and their allies.

stegosaurus.definition: n herbivorous ornithischian dinosaur with a row of bony plates along its back and a spiked tail probably used as a weapon
